author: The Current
description:
Watch a three-song set by The Jayhawks followed by an interview with Gary Louris
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Gary Louris is on a mission to prove that a person in their 70s can still produce some of their best work. That’s indeed rare. But so is keeping a band together for 40 years, being credited as pioneer of Americana music, touring with Johnny Cash … the list goes on for Louris and his iconic Minnesota band, The Jayhawks. 

The Local Show’s September Artist of the Month performed three songs in-studio from their 12th album Sanctuary Park. Producer Bob Ezrin (Pink Floyd, Alice Cooper, Peter Gabriel) volunteered to record the LP after Louris called to catch up with the Canadian legend after he renounced his American citizenship, citing his disgruntlement with the country’s extreme political division. Sanctuary Park, named after the location in Dundas, Ontario, comes with Louris’ perspective of being an American now living in Canada.
title: The Jayhawks perform songs from 'Sanctuary Park' in The Current studio

description:
LP describes their collaboration with Imad Royal and Chloe Angelides on "Don't Stop"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter and musician LP just released their album, “Room 12,” on September 2, 2026. During a visit to The Current for a Gig List interview with host Zach McCormick, LP talked about working with collaborators on the new album; specifically, on their collaboration with Imad Royal and Chloe Angelides on the song, “Don’t Stop.” 

“It’s different people bringing out different sides of you,” LP says, “and I really enjoy that.”
